infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Telemetry uses Bluetooth to discover and securely communicate with nearby Telemetry devices without internet.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Telemetry uses the camera only when you choose Camera to capture media for an encrypted peer-to-peer message.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Telemetry accesses your photo library only when you choose media to send securely to a trusted peer.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Telemetry accesses Contacts only when you choose Contact to share a selected contact with a trusted peer.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Telemetry uses the local network and peer-to-peer Wi-Fi to securely communicate with nearby Telemetry devices without internet.
